0 |](https://www.meridalivingrealestate.com/2121/meridamexicorealestate) [**Code: 2120 $349,000 USD.**\ \ ![](https://www.meridalivingrealestate.com/images/logo/favico.png) Exclusive Listings ![](https://www.meridalivingrealestate.com/images/logo/check.png) Verified docs and taxes\ \ **Casa Verde airy interiors, open heart.** \ \ Open and refreshing, with deeply connected spaces, Casa Verde was designed to blur the line between indoors and outdoors. It is a home where you sometimes forget whether you are inside or outside — and that was entirely intentional. Remodeled by Workshop Arquitectos, the project honors the home’s original character while introducing a contemporary vision centered on natural light, cross ventilation, and spatial continuity. From the entrance, a lush front garden sets the tone. The 6 x 35 meter lot, slightly irregular — beginning at 6 meters wide and tapering to 5.2 meters — creates a striking visual axis that allows you to see through the entire depth of the home from the moment you step inside, generating an immediate sense of openness. The façade preserves its original masonry (mampostería), discreetly integrating a garage without compromising the historic identity. Upon entering, subtle accents of green chukum appear on select walls, adding freshness and warmth. The living room flows naturally toward the staircase leading upstairs, maintaining an open circulation throughout. The kitchen continues the architectural language with an island clad in handcrafted pasta tile flooring, while the architects incorporated tile details throughout the space to unify the design and reinforce its personality. Toward the back, the home opens to the terrace and garden patio, where landscape and architecture meet. It is a home where you sometimes forget whether you are inside or outside — and that was entirely intentional. Remodeled by Workshop Arquitectos, the project honors the home’s original character while introducing a contemporary vision centered on natural light, cross ventilation, and spatial continuity. From the entrance, a lush front garden sets the tone. The 6 x 35 meter lot, slightly irregular — beginning at 6 meters wide and tapering to 5.2 meters — creates a striking visual axis that allows you to see through the entire depth of the home from the moment you step inside, generating an immediate sense of openness. The façade preserves its original masonry (mampostería), discreetly integrating a garage without compromising the historic identity. Upon entering, subtle accents of green chukum appear on select walls, adding freshness and warmth. The living room flows naturally toward the staircase leading upstairs, maintaining an open circulation throughout. The kitchen continues the architectural language with an island clad in handcrafted pasta tile flooring, while the architects incorporated tile details throughout the space to unify the design and reinforce its personality. Toward the back, the home opens to the terrace and garden patio, where landscape and architecture meet. The original well was preserved as a historical vestige, alongside the former rooftop water tank reinterpreted as a sculptural decorative element — blending memory with contemporary design. Upstairs, two bedrooms each feature their own walk-in closet, thoughtfully designed for privacy, airflow, and constant natural light. Casa verde was renovated with Méridas iconic indoor-outdoor lifestyle in mind. A home created to live and enjoy in a tranquil yet connected area of town. Code: 2121 San Cristobal Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- Casa Historic is a partially restored colonial house, ideal for those seeking to preserve the original character of a historic property while adapting it to their own style. With an authentic façade, ceilings over six meters high, and original wooden beams, this house retains the charm and essence of old Mérida. The renovation project has progressed significantly, shaping a functional layout with two spacious bedrooms, two and a half bathrooms, and additional space on the second floor with potential for a third bedroom or study. From the rooftop, you will enjoy spectacular views of the Parroquia de San Cristóbal, a detail that adds value and beauty to this property if you are a fan of homes with soul or patrimonial investments. Half a block from San Cristobal Park 2.5 blocks from San Benito Market and Lucas de Gálvez Market 5.5 blocks from San Juan Park 8.5 blocks from Plaza Grande It is being sold in its current state, offering a solid foundation to continue the project, hand in hand with renowned architect Atahualpa. The images shown are illustrative and correspond to the architectural project that was carried out. However, if you like the design, there is the possibility of purchasing the proposal that includes everything to continue with this historic renovation. Code: 2125 Santa Lucia, Centro Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- Casa Acrelio A historic restoration opportunity in Merida Centro Set on an 11 x 40 meter lot in Merida’s historic center, Casa Acrelio is a property with character, history, and remarkable potential. With its original pasta tile floors, generous proportions, and an expansive backyard patio framed by native trees, it offers the ideal canvas for a thoughtful restoration. Within a 1 km radius, you’ll find some of Mérida’s most iconic landmarks and gathering places, including Santa Ana, Santiago, Santa Lucia, La Plaza Grande, Paseo de Montejo, and the beginning of Calle 47, well known for its restaurants and bars. Markets, banks, and other everyday services are also close by, adding convenience to a property defined not only by its character, but also by its location. Another highly valued feature for this area of Centro is that the property includes space for a garage, an uncommon and practical advantage in this part of the city. For those seeking a project with soul in one of Mérida’s most storied areas, Casa Acrelio presents a rare opportunity to restore and reimagine. The price of this property is tied to a price of $7,200,000 MXN. The USD price will fluctuate as the dollar pesos rate change. Code: 2111 Santiago Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- This colorful, charming home cleverly combines Mexican style and appeal, with comfortable modern conveniences. The inviting corner location is perfectly situated in Colonia Santiago within walking distance to Centro Historico, Santa Ana, Santa Lucia and Merida’s emblematic Paseo Montejo. Immediately close by, Santiago’s celebrated traditional market welcomes you with many stalls offering everything from farm fresh eggs to tropical flowers, and more fruit & vegetable assortments than you could desire. Surrounding the market, the church and the plaza, are numerous cafes and bakeries, providing a wide variety of refreshments and dining choices! Entering the house, every visitor is captivated by the light, and the pleasing palette of colors, handmade tiles, traditional finishes and local artwork. The inviting living room includes a flexible arrangement of comfortable seating options, ideal for entertaining or relaxing with a good book. Adjacent to the living room is a spacious dining room, showcasing a spectacular hand carved dining table with matching chairs, set to accommodate 6. The ornately tiled traditional kitchen includes a 6 burner cooktop, refrigerator, double sink, microwave and oven. The layout of the house offers optimal privacy for each of the 2 spacious bedrooms, both with attractive en-suite bathrooms. From the primary bedroom, there is direct access to an inviting and very magical covered patio, with lush tropical foliage, and a delightful water wall cascading into the sparkling dipping pool beyond. A artfully conceived spiral staircase in one corner of the patio accesses the fully finished roof terrace, perfect for sunbathing or enjoying Merida’s celebrated sunsets. The property has been a very successful rental for several years; however, the layout, amenities and location would also make it an ideal winter getaway or long term retirement house. It is being offered fully furnished, with only the personal items of the seller not included. Code: 1983 Itzimna Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- Situated in the picturesque and historic neighborhood of Itzimná, this exclusive development combines modern living with timeless charm. Ideally located just a short drive from Prolongación de Montejo, Paseo de Montejo, and the Monumento a la Bandera, these residences offer a peaceful setting with convenient access to Mérida’s bustling core. Designed by esteemed local architect Omar Fuentes, the homes boast premium finishes, lush landscaped gardens, and distinctive architectural touches like curved corners that pay homage to the traditional styles of Itzimná and Mérida’s Centro. Each residence includes designated parking and blends contemporary comforts with the neighborhood’s rich historical aesthetic. Scheduled for completion in March/April 2024, this project provides an exceptional opportunity to secure a home in one of Mérida’s most desirable areas. Both units feature private pools and share a beautifully landscaped garden, making this property ideal for living in one unit while renting out the other. It’s a perfect blend of functionality and opportunity in the heart of Itzimná. Renowned for its historic architecture, tree-lined streets, and tranquil atmosphere, Itzimná offers a unique blend of old-world charm and modern convenience. The neighborhood’s proximity to Mérida’s top cultural landmarks, restaurants, and shopping makes it a sought-after location. Code: 2096 Santa Ana Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- A tailor’s legacy reborn in Mérida’s most privileged location In the vibrant heart of Mérida’s Centro Histórico, just steps from Paseo de Montejo, Santa Lucía, and Santa Ana, stands a property that captures everything buyers dream of finding: location, heritage, and design in perfect balance. Casa del Sastre owes its name to Don Víctor, the neighborhood’s beloved tailor who lived and worked here for decades. His story is woven into every wall a reminder that some homes hold more than history; they hold human warmth, craft, and continuity. Lovingly restored by a talented local architect, this residence honors its past while embracing a contemporary lifestyle. Traditional materials , thick mampostería walls, restored pasta tiles, and original wooden doors that merge seamlessly with modern architectural gestures that fill the home with natural light and cross-ventilation. On the ground floor, high ceilings and generous openings connect the living room, dining area, and kitchen, all overlooking the garden and plunge pool. Outside, a wood-fired oven sits next to an outdoor dining area the kind of space made for long Mérida afternoons. Upstairs, three beautifully appointed bedrooms each include their own ensuite bathroom, ensuring privacy and comfort. A terrace crowns the home, framing views of the tropical skyline. What truly sets Casa del Sastre apart, however, is its unmatched location. Situated only three blocks from the iconic Paseo de Montejo and two blocks from Calle 60 and Calle 47, Mérida’s celebrated “Mile-Long Restaurant Street” — this home places you within walking distance of the city’s cultural and culinary pulse. From the Serenata Yucateca at Santa Lucía Park to the markets and cafés of Santa Ana, everything that defines Mérida’s charm is just around the corner. Refined yet livable, historic yet renewed. Casa del Sastre is not just a home, but an heirloom of Mérida’s spirit, ready to be lived in once again. Code: 1817 Hacienda San Jose Chakán Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- Beautiful residence located in Hacienda San Jose Chakan development, this is a gatted community in the countryside. With 1,000 m2 of land this beautiful one level home was very well designed to offers comfort on a peaceful place. The main entrance is surrounded by garden and a nice decorative well at the front, double car garage with electric wooden gate. In the house you can appreciate the 4-meter high ceilings of the social area which consists of a living room with a natural indoor tree from the region, dining room and kitchen with concrete polished island, this social area has a wide open view of the covered terrace with swimming pool and jacuzzi. Its large glass panels windows with wood-colored aluminum finishes allow us to have a nice view from inside the house. Three total bedrooms: the master bedroom with a walk-in closet and private bathroom with double sinks and a panel window door overlooking the pool. A number one secondary bedroom with a walk-in closet and private bathroom and a window overlooking the pool, a number two secundary bedroom with private bathroom with a window to view the back garden. Guest bathroom that has double access from inside the house and from the outside terrace area. A large laundry room that also serves as a storage room with access to the garage and an office next to the entrance. On the outside we have a covered terrace with a wood-colored PVC-lined roof, swimming pool with a filter system and jacuzzi that can be connected to the heater to warm the water during winter season, storage room with the machines systems and a beautiful backyard with fruit trees and ornamental plants with independet service access. The house has 14 solar panels so the entire operation of the house is electric, the air conditioners, the stove, the water heater, the electricity bill is approximately $50 pesos every two months. The water comes from three wells for different purposes in the house, there is a water softener and reverse osmosis for drinking water consumption in the kitchen and the refrigerator. The house has been built with high quality standards, for more information please contact us and we will gladly assist you. Hacienda San Jose has been restored and is open on sundays as a restaurant. This project was designed to have a golf course in the medium term. Distance about two minutes by car from Chicxulub town where you will find a church, park, market, pharmacy, convenience stores, and so on, public transportation passes over the main entrance of this gated community. Merida city is 25 minutes by car. The price is $7,600,000 mxn has been fixed in Mexican pesos, so the price in dollars varies according to the exchange rate of the day. Remodeled by Workshop Arquitectos, the project honors the home’s original character while introducing a contemporary vision centered on natural light, cross ventilation, and spatial continuity. From the entrance, a lush front garden sets the tone. The 6 x 35 meter lot, slightly irregular — beginning at 6 meters wide and tapering to 5.2 meters — creates a striking visual axis that allows you to see through the entire depth of the home from the moment you step inside, generating an immediate sense of openness. The façade preserves its original masonry (mampostería), discreetly integrating a garage without compromising the historic identity. Upon entering, subtle accents of green chukum appear on select walls, adding freshness and warmth. The living room flows naturally toward the staircase leading upstairs, maintaining an open circulation throughout. The kitchen continues the architectural language with an island clad in handcrafted pasta tile flooring, while the architects incorporated tile details throughout the space to unify the design and reinforce its personality. Toward the back, the home opens to the terrace and garden patio, where landscape and architecture meet. The original well was preserved as a historical vestige, alongside the former rooftop water tank reinterpreted as a sculptural decorative element — blending memory with contemporary design. Upstairs, two bedrooms each feature their own walk-in closet, thoughtfully designed for privacy, airflow, and constant natural light. Casa verde was renovated with Méridas iconic indoor-outdoor lifestyle in mind. A home created to live and enjoy in a tranquil yet connected area of town. Code: 2097 Santa Lucia Experts in Merida Real Estate ----------------------------- Casa Namaste is a stunning colonial residence that has been thoughtfully updated to meet modern standards while preserving its original charm. The home showcases the classic architectural elements buyers seek, including an elegant colonial façade, beautiful pasta tile floors, original wood-beamed ceilings, and traditional wooden doors. The layout offers a warm and inviting entry, two comfortable bedrooms, and well-defined living, dining, and kitchen spaces. One of the highlights of the home is the covered terrace, which overlooks the lush garden and swimming pool—an exceptionally generous pool size for properties in this price range, making it ideal for both relaxation and entertaining. The pool is equipped with a heater, allowing for comfortable year-round enjoyment. In addition to its timeless character, the property includes 12 solar panels, significantly improving energy efficiency and reducing operating costs—an increasingly valuable feature for both full-time living and rental use. Located on Calle 52 between 51 and 53, Casa Namaste enjoys an outstanding, hard-to-beat location. Large windows, skylights and sliding doors with screens, optimize light, airflow and the pleasures of Merida’s casual indoor/outdoor lifestyle. The 2 bedroom suites are ideally positioned at the front and the back of the house, offering privacy and independence. Both bedrooms feature showers with direct access to a small private garden, a very thoughtful touch. The bedroom suite at the front features a “Bonus room”, currently a dressing room with particularly ample, custom designed closet space— this room could also be used as a home office or art/writing studio. This home is truly move-in ready, furniture package available on request, and is ideally positioned to be a full time home, a tropical winter retreat, or a proven investment rental opportunity.
